QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Latest Information
QuestInfo.parent: Snow Silk and the Mysterious Fabric
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra, maple world's informant, is said to have obtained some new information hot off the press.  I'm curious what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra told me about the Snow Silk.  But for some reason she wouldn't explain in detail and kept telling me to just go see the archeologist, #bWinston#k...
QuestInfo.2: Maple world's informant, Cassandra, notified me of her latest information, the Snow Silk.  I went to go see Winston, the archaeologist who is looking for this Snow Silk.

0.0: Have you heard of the Snow Silk by any chance?  Judging by your look, you don't have a clue, do you?  You gotta get with the program... If you want to learn about #t4001166#, go see Winston, the archaeologist.  According to rumors, he has been gathering information regarding Snow Silk.

yes.0: Dr. Winston is said to be at the East Rocky Mountain in Perion.  One can only wonder what he is doing in such a bleak and desolate place.

no.0: I guess sharing up-to-date information with you was pointless.  I should warn you...  With that kind of dull brain of yours, you'll go no where!  You hear me?  No where!

1.0: Did you come here for me?  What can I do for you?\r\n#b#L0#I was hoping to learn about the Snow Silk.#l
1.1: Snow Silk?  Oh~ you're talking about the Mysterious Fabric.  That's right~ I was inquiring about the Snow Silk recently.  Did you hear something about the Mysterious Fabric as well?

npc.0: I already told you to go see Dr. Winston at the East Rocky Mountain in Perion. This is getting frustrating.
